method.pixel_rule: centre inclusion; half-open scanline edges; even-odd ring parity

coordinate_conversion.description: Inverse of Popular Visualisation Pseudo-Mercator + Inverse of NAD83 to WGS 84 (1) + Conus Albers
coordinate_conversion.definition: proj=pipeline step inv proj=webmerc lat_0=0 lon_0=0 x_0=0 y_0=0 ellps=WGS84 step proj=aea lat_0=23 lon_0=-96 lat_1=29.5 lat_2=45.5 x_0=0 y_0=0 ellps=GRS80

method.polygon_edges: straight segments between transformed original vertices
method.coverage: every original polygon is wholly inside the supplied native raster rectangle
